top_signals.title: Treasuries Rise as Falling Oil Prices Trim Fed Rate-Hike Wagers
top_signals.summary: Treasuries rose on Tuesday as signs of progress toward a diplomatic resolution of the Iran war sent oil prices lower, curbing expectations for more than one Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in the coming year.
